card.name: Start of self-care advice lists
card.fires_on: Words and punctuation at the start or hinge of a self-care or prevention instruction, such as an opening "Do" or "Try to", or the punctuation just before advice follows.

modes.label: Instruction openers
modes.description: Imperative verbs or "to" that start a tip in a list of lifestyle advice.
modes.example: Treatment options include the following: <<Try>> to eat frequent, small meals, bland

modes.label: Sentence ends after advice
modes.description: Period or colon closing an advice clause, just before the next tip or explanation.
